name: title-map-menu-save

steps.eval: (function(){if($gameMap.mapId() !== 92) throw new Error('Expected map 92'); return true;})()

Promise.resolve(DataManager.saveGame(1)).then(function(ok){if(ok === false) throw new Error('Save failed'); __ev.savedGameSystem = $gameSystem; $gameSystem._evaluatorReloadProbe = true; if(!StorageManager.exists(DataManager.makeSavename(1))) throw new Error('Slot 1 missing'); return true;})

Promise.resolve(DataManager.loadGame(1)).then(function(ok){if(ok === false || $gameSystem === __ev.savedGameSystem || $gameSystem._evaluatorReloadProbe) throw new Error('Reload failed'); $gameSystem.onAfterLoad(); SceneManager.goto(Scene_Map); return true;})
